transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Hi. Um, I guess I came in because, for a really long time now, I just wake up already feeling low. It's like... there's this heavy, gray feeling on me before I even get to the clinic for work, and it pretty much just follows me through the whole day.
How long have you been feeling this way most days?

Um, it's been going on for about two years and two months now. It started right around the time the staffing changed at the clinic, and my schedule just started rotating all over the place. I've felt this way pretty much ever since then.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Um, no, I haven't really noticed that. I mean, I still like doing the same stuff I've always liked when I'm not at the clinic. It's just... I just have that heavy feeling hanging over me while I do them. But I wouldn't say I've lost interest in things.
Have you noticed feeling fatigued or having low energy most days, even when you haven't been doing much physically?

Yeah, I definitely have low energy. Even after I have a day off or I sleep in late, my body just still feels completely worn out. By the time I finish rooming patients and catching up on all the charts at work, it's like I have absolutely nothing left in the tank. I don't even have the energy to do my laundry, go shoot hoops, or mess around with my electronics stuff like I usually do. I'm just drained.
Do you feel depressed most of the day, nearly every day, not just feeling low or fatigued?

Yeah, it's not just the energy thing. I mean, that's why I came in, because for a long time now, I just... I wake up already feeling low. It's like there's this heavy, gray feeling on me before I even step foot in the clinic, and it pretty much follows me through the whole entire day.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety more often than not?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't feel like I'm moving in slow motion or anything, and I'm not really the jittery type either. I just feel... heavy, I guess. But my speech and how I move seem pretty normal to me.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty, maybe even blaming yourself for things that aren't your fault, most days?

No, not really. I don't think I feel worthless, and I don't really sit around feeling guilty or blaming myself for things. I mean, I know I'm doing my job at the clinic fine, it's just... I'm just so drained and down all the time. But yeah, no guilt or anything like that.
Have you noticed any trouble thinking clearly, focusing, or making decisions most days?

Yeah, I definitely have. At work, I’ll just be staring at a patient’s intake screen and I have to reread the same line over and over again. I've even caught myself missing little details, like medication doses, or just... mixing up what I was about to ask the patient next. So yeah, focusing has been pretty tough.
Have you ever felt like life isn't worth living or had thoughts about ending your life?

No, I haven't. I mean, I know I'm feeling really down and tired all the time, but I've never thought about... you know, ending it or anything like that. I don't feel like life isn't worth living, it's just... it's just really hard to get through the days right now. But no, no thoughts like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, like having trouble falling asleep, waking up too early, or sleeping much more than usual?

No, my sleep has been pretty normal, actually. I don't really have trouble falling asleep, and I'm not waking up in the middle of the night or anything. I just get my regular amount of sleep, but... I just still feel so tired all the time anyway. But yeah, the sleeping part itself hasn't changed.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt down or lost interest in things almost every day, before this two-year period?

No, I don't think so. It's just been this... this same low feeling for the last couple of years. I don't remember any specific two-week time before that where it was worse or where I totally lost interest in everything. It's just been this constant thing for a long time now.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually high, elated, or extremely energetic, even for a few days or more?

No, I haven't. I've never felt anything like that. It's really just been this constant low feeling, like I said. Never any time where I felt super energetic or high or anything. Just... always tired and down.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over the past couple of years while you've been feeling this way?
No, not really. My appetite has been pretty much the same as always. I eat regular meals, and my weight hasn't really changed at all. It's just... normal, I guess.
Were there any major stressful events, changes, or difficulties happening in your life around the time your mood started to change two years ago?

Yeah, actually. This has all been going on for about two years and two months now. It started right around the time the staffing changed at the clinic where I work as a medical assistant. They started rotating my schedule all over the place, and it's just been like this ever since.
Have you experienced any other symptoms along with feeling low and fatigued, such as changes in appetite, trouble sleeping, feelings of hopelessness, or difficulty concentrating?

Well, I already said my appetite is fine, but... yeah, the hopelessness is definitely there. I just keep thinking that this is exactly how life is going to be now. Just working these random hours, constantly falling behind. It feels like I'm never going to get enough money or energy to actually move forward with school or... or anything better, really.

Do you feel that your low mood is mainly a reaction to the ongoing stress of the unpredictable work schedule and the changes at the clinic, or does it feel like something that goes beyond that stressor?

I don't really know, to be honest. I mean, the schedule changes definitely started it all. But now... I'm not sure if it's just the job anymore. It feels like even if they gave me normal hours tomorrow, I'd probably still feel exactly this way. It's just hard to tell where the work stress ends and everything else begins.
Have there been any distinct periods during these two years where your low mood and other symptoms noticeably got worse for a time, even if just for a few weeks?

No, I don't think so. It hasn't really gotten worse for a few weeks or anything like that. It's just been a steady, constant feeling this whole time. I haven't really noticed any periods where it suddenly dipped or felt different. It's just... always the same level of low.
Have you ever noticed any distinct times when your mood or energy felt even worse than usual, even if only for a few days?

No, not really. Like I was just saying, it doesn't really change. Even if it's just for a couple of days... no, I haven't noticed a drop like that. It's really just a flat line. Every day just feels exactly the same as the last one, it doesn't really crash any lower.
